statement: If U_n/n has almost-sure limsup at most mu-c for a deterministic c>0 and V_n/n converges almost surely to mu under their marginal laws, then for ANY coupling and every 0<epsilon<c/2, P((V_n-U_n)/n>=c-2epsilon) tends to 1.
